title: デビュー戦の後に・宵の狭間に

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant… Pant…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Ahh…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Wind lashing at my skin as I tear across the turf… The sensation lingers, etched into me.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (To the front, to the future, to victory. The heat that's burned away at my life… It's become a pounding bell in my chest…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I feel so hot!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …This is how I start the Twinkle Series—I've taken my very first step!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ramonu's little sister really gave it her all. Think she'll ever catch up to the family superstar?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Hmm, we're talking about the crown jewel of the Mejiro family here… Ramonu's running is on another level entirely.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Even if my light has yet to shine as hers does…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Someday, it will make a lasting impression on everyone here! I shall make it happen!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With Mejiro Ardan's debut race in the books, I head out to meet her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Your efforts allowed me to dedicate myself fully to this moment—this race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: However… that notion is mine, and mine alone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I was unable to impress my light upon the spectators in attendance today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: At this moment, my light can do little more than conjure memories of my sister's glory…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I swear that someday I will come to emit a radiance all my own—bright enough for all to see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Now, let's be getting back…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: To… today's—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan collapses. I rush to catch her, then put a finger to her pulse. She's conscious, fortunately, but on the brink of total exhaustion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's immediately taken to the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After undergoing a thorough medical examination that confirms her life isn't in danger, Mejiro Ardan starts to look a little better.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just to be on the safe side, it's decided that she'll spend the rest of the day recuperating at the Mejiro family's rest house.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I do apologize for worrying you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer? I…

text_block_list.name: Chief Physician
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. You're Mejiro Ardan's trainer, yes? May I have a moment? There's something I'd like to discuss with you.

text_block_list.name: Chief Physician
text_block_list.text: Please, follow me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Yes, I shall.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After leading me to another room, the Mejiro family's chief physician asks me to take a seat.

text_block_list.name: Chief Physician
text_block_list.text: If you'll allow me to be frank, I'm concerned about Lady Ardan's present condition.

text_block_list.name: Chief Physician
text_block_list.text: It may be in the young mistress's best interests to step away from racing for the time being and convalesce here at the rest house. Simply put…

text_block_list.name: Chief Physician
text_block_list.text: Speaking as her physician, I'd like you to contemplate whether it's truly necessary for her to rush into the Twinkle Series at this juncture.

text_block_list.name: Chief Physician
text_block_list.text: I suspect that Lady Ardan bottled up so much stress and fatigue that when the race was finally over, everything caught up to her at once.

text_block_list.name: Chief Physician
text_block_list.text: The bodily wear and tear from training… The mental pressure and anxiety she felt leading up to her debut…

text_block_list.name: Chief Physician
text_block_list.text: All of that, amplified by the intensity of a real race—more taxing than any training bout thus far.

text_block_list.name: Chief Physician
text_block_list.text: When she let herself relax at the end, the effects of all these stressors came crashing down on her…

text_block_list.name: Chief Physician
text_block_list.text: If the young mistress sets her sights on even bigger races, the weight on her shoulders will surely be far greater than it was today.

text_block_list.name: Chief Physician
text_block_list.text: As her trainer, I believe that you—better than anyone—should be able to grasp the gravity of this situation.

text_block_list.name: Chief Physician
text_block_list.text: I'm well aware of the young mistress's passion for racing, and I would never make light of her devotion to it.

text_block_list.name: Chief Physician
text_block_list.text: And though the final decision falls to Lady Ardan, I do ask that, as her trainer, you keep all of this in mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the conversation with the physician, Mejiro Ardan's nanny drives me back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Thank you ever so much for all you've done to assist Lady Ardan today. On behalf of the Mejiro family, you have our deepest gratitude.
choice_data_list: Oh, oh no, I didn't do much at all.
Oh, oh no, I didn't do much at all.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text: …The master and mistress spoke with Lady Ardan earlier today.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text: Apparently, they urged that she reconsider her decision to devote her life to racing.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text: I've served the young mistress since she was but an infant, and I've no trouble at all discerning the nature of desires and her heartaches.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text: With that in mind, I have a request for you—the trainer who is to walk beside Lady Ardan at this academy.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text: I implore you to make the decision that is best for her.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text: I have the utmost faith that you, whom the young mistress herself chose, are able to do that.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text: Now, if you'll excuse me, I bid you good evening.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …The decision that's best for Mejiro Ardan. What could that be?

text_block_list.name: Chief Physician
text_block_list.text: Speaking as her physician, I'd like you to contemplate whether it's truly necessary for her to rush into the Twinkle Series at this juncture.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text: Apparently, they urged that she reconsider her decision to devote her life to racing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …I know Ardan has her doubts, but I believe in her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I have faith that she'll ace her debut and be able to race together with Yaeno and me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I may fade away and be forgotten. And yet, here and now…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I still wish to shine, and I'm willing to do whatever it takes to do so.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan's words from that day echo in my head.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …What was I wavering for? My mind's been made up all this time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm determined to go on being Mejiro Ardan's trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Which means, as her trainer, there's only one thing for me to do!
